description: RAPID: Exploring Impacts of Cascading Failure and Recovery Efforts of Interdependent Critical Infrastructure in Socially Vulnerable Puerto Rican Communities After Hurricane Fiona is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Diana Ramirez-Rios, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). To explore how the failure of the electric grid and the transportation infrastructure impacted socially vulnerable communities in the aftermath of Hurricane Fiona and understand how the recovery and reconstruction efforts of these interdependent infrastructures are prioritized for rapid recovery of the communities. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Hurricane Fiona, Puerto Rican Communities. Published 2024-04-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
